release_notes: Live TV: D-pad navigation overhaul — category list remembers your place, Back now steps out through the TV Guide tab with an exit confirmation instead of quitting instantly. Sports Bar: pinned games auto-clear after full-time and at next launch, added Scottish Premiership, league tabs now navigate down into Games/Table, fixed standings row colour striping. Emby: smaller, denser poster grid. EPG: fixed guide data sometimes only partially loading on app launch.
